svg.title: Portable gasoline generator — Isolated portable load
svg.desc: Isolated portable load. 7 equipment references and 6 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
svg.text: Isolated portable load · declared connections · illustrative equipment symbols
